title: Book Three · Chapter 70: One Bag on Saturday
story:
On Friday, Ronan brings home two pages of school work.

The second page needs more time than he expected. He finishes one part before dinner, then finds another question on the back.

Mum has two garment bags ready beside her chair. One customer is near the fruit shop. The other lives across the busy road.

“Tomorrow?” Ronan asks.

“The first one. The second can wait until next week.”

He looks at his half-finished page. Two bags mean a little more money. One route means he can be home before noon.

“I thought I could do both.”

“You can take the second another day.”

Mum starts to move it away. Ronan keeps a hand on the bag for a moment.

“I said I would help.”

She looks at the open book on the table.

“You helped. Those sleeves are finished because I stayed here while you walked. Tomorrow is one bag.”

He lets go. Mum puts the second bag on a shelf and turns back to her work sheet.

At dinner, Dad asks about the two pages. Ronan shows him the last question.

Dad reads it slowly. Then he reads the example above it.

“Not tonight's quick question,” he says.

“I know.”

“Where did you stop?”

Ronan shows him. Dad knows the measurements, but not the method in the new book. He does not take the pencil.

They look at the example together. Ronan finds the next step and writes it himself.

Dad returns to his rice. Mum tells him about a customer who wants a pocket for a very large bunch of keys.

“A bag,” Dad says. “He wants a bag.”

“He calls it a pocket.”

Ronan laughs and moves his paper away from the vegetables.

After dinner, he takes the one delivery bag to the shelf near the door. The other stays beside Mum's work.

He checks the customer's name and the street. It is the shorter route. He can walk there and back in the morning.

Then he opens his book again. The last question is still waiting, but the first line is no longer empty.

Mum carries her tea into the yard. Dad washes the bowls. For a while, Ronan has the table to himself.

He works through the example once more. At the bottom of the page, he writes a small question mark beside one number. He will ask about that part in class.

When Mum comes back, he has closed both books.

“One bag tomorrow,” he says.

She nods. “And bring your hands home warm.”

He pulls his coat onto the chair and finds the gloves at the bottom of his bag.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

route＝路线；method＝方法；measurement＝尺寸、测量数据；glove＝手套。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan为什么最终只送一个袋子？第二件工作是否因此没人处理？
2. Dad有没有假装懂新书里的所有解法？Ronan对仍不确定的地方做了什么？

## 读句子

**Ronan finds the next step and writes it himself.**

拆开看：Ronan / finds the next step / and writes it himself.

Ronan／找到了下一步／自己写下来。
